newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schiphol expects decision fron Eindhoven community.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol expects decision fron Eindhoven community.

text.p: Schiphol airport management hope a decision will be made soon regarding the future of Eindhoven airport. The decision may lead to more cooperation between the two airports, a Schiphol airport spokesman said.
Schiphol may even take a stake in the southern Dutch airport and take a role in Eindhoven's future management if its gets the go-ahead, he added.
Already, Schiphol, the Netherlands' main gateway airport, manages Rotterdam airport.
At the moment the decision rests with the province of North Brabant, Eindhoven City and the airport and the local community, added the spokesman.
Schiphol believes that there are too many limitations placed on Eindhoven airport at the moment, he said.
"The community has some worries about the amount of aircraft movements and noise levels, but Schiphol would introduce measures to discourage noisy aircraft like the ones at Schiphol."
"The community has to decide whether it wants a change. But we believe Eindhoven can be economically viable under certain conditions," he said.
Rotterdam airport, he points out, has been in the black since Schiphol took over its management in the early 1990s.

Schiphol is also keen to form a similar relationship with Maastricht Aachen airport, but the Dutch government recently announced that this regional airport would also be subject to tight restrictions regarding the number of flights it can handle.
Possible cooperation initiatives between the two airports are currently under study. But Schiphol expects to make its position clear to the Ministry of Transport, said the spokesman.
"Our study will make clear under which condiitons it will be willing to take a stake in Maastricht in the next few months," he added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
